[EN] You don't think these crystals can hurt me, do you? I mean, they glow and crackle softly. If I'm keeping 'em next to MY jewels, am I going to regret it?
[ES] No crees que estos Crystal puedan hacerme daño, ¿verdad? Digo, brillan y chisporrotean suavemente. Si los guardo junto a MIS joyas, ¿voy a arrepentirme?
